purpose: Pin the exact finite joint GW--GBM association statistic and background-calibration choices documented by the primary Stachie et al. implementation, as an additive source-owner candidate for T-059 without substituting it for the continuous Delta_t_det contract.

authority_pointers.role: candidate-neutral continuous timing and four-stage map contract
P1900186 finite Lambda/R crosswalk continued by this source

official_source.title: Search for Advanced LIGO Single Interferometer Compact Binary Coalescence Signals in Coincidence with Gamma-Ray Events in Fermi-GBM
official_source.source_role: Primary methodological paper; it documents the finite association search but does not provide the event-specific HOLD-LC-001 response and propagation owner packet.

exact_scope.finite_scope: Source-documented finite single-interferometer GW--GBM association statistic, its finite search inputs, and empirical background calibration only.
included: Single-detector GW trigger threshold and reweighted-SNR input role.
GBM Targeted Search window, timescale, LLR threshold and maximum-LLR candidate selection.
Joint Bayes-factor form with time-overlap and sky-overlap terms.
GBM and LIGO noise-versus-signal factor construction, source-reported KDE and high-tail conventions.
Triangular finite time-overlap kernel and finite sky-overlap integral.
Time-shifted GBM background procedure and empirical FAR mapping.
excluded: Event-level response-matrix values or validity/interpolation selection.
Detector-to-geocenter propagation, spacecraft-state interpolation or Earth-orientation correction.
Continuous pulse-onset estimator, timing covariance or intrinsic-emission-lag law.
F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs construction, candidate scoring or prospective holdout.

gw: reweighted SNR rho_hat_gw with threshold rho_hat_gw >= 8
gbm: Targeted Search over +/-30 s around the GW time
retain the highest LLR window when LLR >= 5

hypotheses: HC: both data sets contain signals from a common source
HNN, HSN, HNS and HSS: the four non-common-source alternatives
association_statistic.factorized_form: Lambda = I_Delta_t * I_Omega / (1 + Q_L + Q_G + Q_L * Q_G)
association_statistic.time_term: Delta_t = t_EM - t_GW, with t_EM the center of the maximum-LLR GBM window and t_GW the estimated GW merger time
association_statistic.sky_term: I_Omega = integral P(Omega | D_L) P(Omega | D_G) / P(Omega) dOmega, with uniform P(Omega) = 1/(4 pi)

finite_time_kernel.interpretation: The source assumes equal GW and EM propagation speed but leaves intrinsic source emission offset incompletely known; the chosen kernel is a finite search prior, not a physical lag law.

distribution_and_background.gbm_signal_and_noise: Real-signal and O2-background LLR histograms are KDE-fitted over source-specified ranges; the high-LLR tail uses the source-reported LLR^-4 convention.
distribution_and_background.gw_signal_and_noise: L1/H1 and O1/O2 rho_hat_gw distributions are histogram/KDE based with source-reported threshold and rho_hat_gw^-4 high-tail convention.
distribution_and_background.far: Run the same GBM Targeted Search configuration on a 23-day background interval, time-shift GBM triggers by nonzero integer multiples of 50 s, and map Lambda to FAR using total coincident live time.
distribution_and_background.calibration_role: Empirical retrospective background calibration for unrelated GW--GBM pairs.

partial_owner_fields: Finite triangular time-overlap and sky-overlap definitions.
Versioned search thresholds and source-reported KDE/tail conventions.
not_admitted: Continuous Delta_t_det likelihood for the physical pulse onset.
Detector-to-geocenter conversion and its uncertainty decomposition.
Fermi rsp2 segment validity/interpolation and gain/response calibration linkage.
Joint timing covariance including GW, GBM, calibration and shared-source terms.
Intrinsic-emission-lag nuisance law or set-valued physical scorer.
F_reg, F_lim, F_eff, F_obs, candidate map, prospective lock or microscopic forward map.

checks.detail: The primary PDF states the common-source hypothesis set, factorized Lambda, Q_L/Q_G terms, time and sky overlap terms, and the finite background construction.
The source supplies a finite association-statistic owner candidate but not the event response, propagation, covariance or intrinsic-lag fields required by HOLD-LC-001.
The published search, KDE fits and background interval remain retrospective method provenance and are not credited as a prospective holdout.
The T-054 forward proof method and T-059 inverse contract are preserved; this card adds a source-bound candidate only.

finding: The primary Stachie et al. paper advances the T-061 intake from a high-level finite R summary to an explicit finite association-statistic implementation: it gives the competing hypotheses, the factorized Lambda, Q_L/Q_G construction, triangular time prior, sky-overlap integral and reproducible time-shifted background calibration. These objects can occupy partial statistical-owner fields, but they remain a retrospective finite search statistic. The paper does not supply the event-specific response/propagation/covariance packet or a continuous detector-timing and intrinsic-lag map, so HOLD-LC-001 admission and candidate scoring remain stopped.
decision_reason: This is a new primary implementation paper that fills previously unspecified finite statistical semantics and gives a reproducible background-calibration protocol. It narrows the next owner request without changing either proof method or promoting a finite ranking to a physical timing likelihood.
decision_scope: T0 finite retrospective source-statistic owner candidate only; no continuous timing, physical identification, dynamics or empirical prediction.
assumptions: arXiv:2001.01462v2 is the intended version of the implementation cited by P1900186.
The source-reported thresholds, priors, KDE ranges, high-tail conventions and time shifts are recorded as implementation choices, not independently re-derived constants.
The local HOLD-LC-001 estimator and response-owner contracts remain controlling for continuous timing and physical-owner admission.
The source's triangular time term is a finite search prior and cannot be reused as an intrinsic-emission-lag law without a separate owner.
missing_assumptions: Versioned event-level GBM input bytes and a reproducible pulse estimator linked to the selected response products.
Source-owned response validity/interpolation, gain calibration and detector-to-geocenter conversion with uncertainty.
A common covariance or likelihood for GW merger time, GBM onset/background, calibration and source-selection terms.
A source-owned intrinsic-lag nuisance model or preregistered set-valued scorer.
A sealed prospective holdout and an independently reproduced F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map.

adversarial_review.check: Could the triangular I_Delta_t term be promoted to the physical emission-lag law?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: the paper presents it as a finite search choice under incomplete source-offset knowledge, not a measured or physical lag distribution.

adversarial_review.check: Could Lambda be inserted directly as the HOLD-LC-001 continuous Delta_t_det likelihood?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: Lambda combines finite trigger significance and overlap terms and does not define the event pulse-onset response/propagation likelihood.

adversarial_review.check: Could the KDE and power-law tails supply the missing calibration or covariance budget?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: they model retrospective trigger-statistic distributions and do not decompose response, timing or shared-source uncertainty.

adversarial_review.check: Could the 23-day time-shift background count as an unused prospective holdout?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: it calibrates the published retrospective search statistic and is not sealed for a new candidate scorer.

adversarial_review.check: Could this source replace the established forward or inverse research method?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: the card is an additive T-061 source-owner refinement and leaves T-054/T-059 unchanged.

evidence_level: T0 primary methodological source with bounded formula and implementation extraction; no event-level numerical reproduction
next_action: Use the Stachie formula and finite background protocol as a versioned partial statistical-owner checklist. Seek the source code or exact event-level implementation artifacts that bind GBM pulse extraction, rsp2 selection, calibration, detector-to-geocenter conversion and uncertainty; independently reproduce the finite statistic only after those inputs are frozen, and keep continuous scoring and prospective credit locked.
stop_or_redesign: If no versioned event inputs or implementation owner can be obtained, retain this card as finite method provenance and do not admit HOLD-LC-001.
If a source changes the triangular time prior, KDE/tail convention or background construction after target disclosure, issue a new version and invalidate any prospective use.
If continuous timing and covariance remain absent, report the finite association statistic only and do not substitute it for Delta_t_det.
If static-equivalent candidates remain indistinguishable under every admitted dynamic observable, report the equivalence class rather than selecting one representative.
non_claims: This card does not establish a continuous detector-level timing likelihood, covariance, response calibration or geocenter correction.
The triangular time term is not an intrinsic-emission-lag law and the retrospective background is not a prospective holdout.

No F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map, candidate score, microscopic forward map, physical identity, QFT/Yang--Mills/gravity result, Pre-A, C6, A13, Sector-A, continuum, physical-vacuum, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything or mass-gap claim follows.
